name: Corthipan Inlet
description: Place where the Torrent should feed the marshes and Caliphear finds it blocked.

timeline.summary: At the Corthipan Inlet Caliphear finds the Torrent blocked and meets Altair, whose enchantment redirects her magic; they ally for ten years of his service.
timeline.quote: In exchange for her help, Altair offers her ten years of service. Caliphear accepts.

citation.text: "Nightmare (comic)", section "Meeting Altair". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4196 AR Coldraith blocks the Corthipan Inlet, draining the swamp and flooding the plains to the north.
timeline.quote: the wizard Coldraith blocked off the Corthipan Inlet
